title: Management Trainee
summary: A management trainee joins a large company straight from an MBA or PGDM and spends 12 to 24 months rotating through functions such as sales, supply chain and finance, with live projects in each. At the end the trainee is placed as a junior manager, often first in frontline sales.
dailyDuties: Spend a rotation in the field with frontline sales teams and distributors
Work on a live project set by a business mentor
Analyse sales, cost or supply data in Excel
Visit plants, depots or warehouses during the supply chain stint
Present project findings and recommendations to leaders
Join monthly business reviews with the finance team

skills.expectation: Build clean Excel sheets to analyse sales, cost and supply data
Use pivot tables and lookups to summarise large data sets
Present project findings to senior managers in a short slide deck
Read a P&L and balance sheet and work out basic ratios
Run field or survey research with retailers and consumers
Put together a cost-benefit case for a project recommendation
Write and speak clearly with frontline teams and leaders
Work across sales, supply chain and finance teams during rotations
Break an open business problem into steps and data checks
Learn distributor and retailer sales during the frontline sales stint
Support demand planning during a supply chain rotation
Look at stock levels and service at depots or plants
Help with monthly business reviews during a finance rotation
Use Lean or Six Sigma tools on a plant or process project
Build a simple dashboard for a project

certifications.why: Shows Excel skill before campus interviews; not usually asked
